text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, April 21, 2020, Appeal DDRT2020-06.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog, and directed that the conditions of the order remain in effect, and that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Deborah Powell Wells and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before February 5, 2021.
